Pärson is an investor in fuboTV through leading venture capital fund Northzone, where he has been a General Partner since 2004. He has appeared several times in Forbes ’ prestigious Midas List. “Like our recently-appointed Chairman of the Board Edgar Bronfman Jr., PJ was an early champion of fuboTV,” said David Gandler, co-founder and C
